# Welcome to Claude Code Mastery

16 Phases, 64 Modules

From installation to real-world mastery. Comprehensive coverage of every Claude Code feature.

16 Phases, 64 Modules

From installation to real-world mastery. Comprehensive coverage of every Claude Code feature.

Bilingual: EN + VI

Full content in English and Vietnamese. Learn in your preferred language.

Hands-On Practice

Every module includes exercises, cheat sheets, and real-world case studies.

Enterprise Ready

Team collaboration, governance, automation, and security best practices.

| Part | Phases | Focus |
|---|---|---|
Foundation | 1-3 | Getting started, security, core workflows |
Intermediate | 4-8 | Prompting, context, thinking modes, debugging |
Advanced | 9-12 | Legacy code, team collaboration, automation |
Mastery | 13-16 | Data analysis, optimization, real-world application |

**ShipWithAI** — Community-driven AI dev tools & education

*"Adding Wings to the Tiger"* — Combine the discipline of a 12-year veteran with the speed of AI to build world-class software.

**"Don't just code. Ship."**

A global community for builders, indie hackers, and engineers who use AI to turn ideas into reality.
